name: scopeguard
displayName: ScopeGuard — Google Cloud IAM Remediation & Least-Privilege Co-Pilot
description: Admin & Developer Google Cloud IAM Remediation Co-Pilot that complements Google Cloud Security Command Center (SCC) and Wiz: 11 modular skills turning SCC/Wiz findings and Active Assist signals into replay-verified Terraform HCL patches, disjoint custom roles (Model A/B), developer 403 minimal-fix debugging, 90-day Audit Log breakglass simulation, CIS/SOC2/ISO/PCI compliance evidence, PAM JIT entitlements, Workload Identity Federation, auto-patching GitOps PR guardrails, IAM v2 Deny Policies, and Org Hierarchy auditing — backed by versioned per-project GCS storage.
suggestedPrompts: Run a full ScopeGuard IAM governance assessment on project my-gcp-project and publish the results to GCS.
Sweep all active GCP projects in organization 123456789012 (or folder <FOLDER_ID>) with ScopeGuard and publish a fleet rollup to GCS.
Remediate these Google Cloud SCC and Wiz IAM findings for my-gcp-project into a replay-verified Terraform patch and ticket-closure evidence.
My Cloud Run service account hit a 403 PERMISSION_DENIED error for secretmanager.versions.access in my-gcp-project — calculate the minimal safe IAM fix.
Design a least-privilege custom role for a Cloud Run Gemini RAG service account in my-gcp-project and publish to GCS.
Simulate whether our proposed Model B custom roles would cause any 403 errors against 90-day Audit Logs in my-gcp-project.
Scan our Terraform files for IAM drift, generate an auto-remediated HCL patch, and produce a SOC 2 / CIS GCP compliance report for my-gcp-project.
